notes:
### Fixes
- Updater: Install & Restart now runs the downloaded setup silently (/VERYSILENT) and the app relaunches automatically on the new version — no wizard to click through
- Installer: taskkill no longer uses /T (process tree), which could kill the setup process itself when launched from the in-app updater
- Installer: post-install relaunch entry no longer skipped in silent mode

### Note
- First update from v1.3.0 still shows the setup wizard once (old client launches it without silent flags); every update after that is fully silent
